Staff Directory & Leadership Team 

 
ICF does not maintain a publicly available comprehensive staff directory. However, our leadership team and key functional contacts are available: 
 

Leadership structure: 


Big Cheese (CEO) — Overall strategic direction 

Head of Rind (COO) — Day-to-day operations and member services 

Curd Commander (Chief Education Officer) — Certifications, courses, and CE 

Wheel Wrangler (Chief Membership Officer) — Enrollment, dues, and chapters 

Mold Maestro (Chief Research & Standards Officer) — Standards, research, and advocacy 

Brie-lance Officer (CFO) — Budget, dues processing, and financial assistance 

Cheddar Champion (Director of Events) — Conference, symposia, and webinars 

Gouda Guru (Director of Communications) — PR, member comms, and digital resources 
 

These affectionate cheese-pun nicknames reflect ICF’s approachable culture! Formal titles are used for official communications, contracts, and legal documents. 

 
For official leadership details, visit 
morecheese.org/about-page 
. 
 
 
  
 


Who should I contact for a specific issue? 

 

Membership: 
Dues, renewal, tier changes → 
membership@intlcheese.org 

 

Certifications: 
Exam scheduling, credential status → 
credentials@intlcheese.org 
(Jennifer Park, Director of Credentialing) 
 

Education: 
Courses, CEUs, requirements → 
education@intlcheese.org 

 

Events: 
Conference registration, logistics → 
events@intlcheese.org 

 

Billing: 
Invoice questions, payment issues → 
billing@intlcheese.org 
(Sarah Chen, Billing Manager) 
 

Technical/Standards: 
Industry standards, technical guidance → 
research@intlcheese.org 

 

General: 
Anything else → 
memberservices@intlcheese.org 

 
 
  
 


Organizational Structure & Governance 

 
ICF is a global organization established in 1964, representing the cheese industry across 70+ countries in 5 global regions (Europe, Americas, Asia-Pacific, Africa, Middle East), with over 30 expert staff members. 
 

Executive Leadership: 
CEO (strategic direction) and COO (day-to-day operations). 
 

Functional Leadership: 
Chief Education Officer (certifications and courses), Chief Membership Officer (membership and chapters), Chief Research & Standards Officer (standards and research), and Chief Finance Officer (budget and dues processing). 
 

Department Directors: 
Director of Events, Director of Communications, Director of Credentialing (Jennifer Park), and Billing Manager (Sarah Chen). 
 

Regional Structure: 
14 active chapters across North America provide local member services, networking events, and regional training programs. 
 

Board of Directors: 
Board composition and meeting minutes are available to members in the portal under “Governance.” For board-related inquiries, contact 
ceo@intlcheese.org 
. 
 
 
  
 


Where is ICF headquartered? 

 

Global Headquarters (Brussels, Belgium): 


International coordination, standards development, research programs, and global advocacy. Codex Alimentarius representation. 

Phone: +32 2 706 1730 

Email: 
info@intlcheese.org 


Website: 
morecheese.org 

 

Americas Regional Office (Cheese City, Wisconsin, USA): 


North American member services, 14-chapter coordination across US and Canada, regional events and training. 

Phone: +1 (555) 123-4567 

Email: 
americas@intlcheese.org 

 
For member services questions specific to North America, the Americas office typically provides faster response. ICF also has regional presence across Europe, Asia-Pacific, Africa, and the Middle East. 
 
 
  
 


Can I speak with someone on the leadership team? 

 
For general member inquiries, our member services team handles most questions efficiently at 
memberservices@intlcheese.org 
. 
 

For issues requiring leadership attention: 


Escalated membership concerns → 
membership@intlcheese.org 
(Chief Membership Officer) 

Strategic partnerships → 
partnerships@intlcheese.org 


Board-related matters → 
ceo@intlcheese.org 


Urgent operational issues → Contact the COO via memberservices@intlcheese.org with “URGENT” in subject 
 

Direct staff contact: 
For privacy and security reasons, ICF staff do not publish direct phone numbers or personal email addresses. All inquiries should be directed through departmental email addresses. For urgent matters, call the Global Headquarters (+32 2 706 1730) or Americas Regional Office (+1 (555) 123-4567) and ask for the appropriate department. 
 
 
  
 


Is ICF hiring? 

 
For current job openings and career opportunities at ICF, visit our careers page at 
morecheese.org/careers 
or email 
HR@intlcheese.org 
for inquiries. 
 
ICF offers positions in member services, education, events, communications, and administration across our global operations. 
 
 
 
 
 
Still have questions? 
 
Contact Member Services at 

memberservices@intlcheese.org 

or call 

+1 (555) 123-4567
